concerns.text: FR-007 explicitly requires 'attention-weighted token overlap' to identify recovery segments. T014 (and T006) explicitly forbid 'model attention' and mandate 'semantic state-diff' heuristics instead. There is no task covering the specific 'attention-weighted' calculation required by the spec, creating a coverage gap for a mandatory functional requirement.

FR-001 mandates downloading the 'Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench' dataset. T004 implements fetching the 'AgentBench' dataset. While the plan justifies this substitution, the tasks document lacks a specific task to verify the dataset variable availability (required by Edge Cases) or to formally document the dataset substitution logic as a prerequisite before execution, risking a hard crash if the assumption fails.

FR-008 mandates a fallback to 'Cochran-Armitage' if logistic regression power is < 0.8. T029 implements the fallback logic but lacks a specific task to 'calculate or check statistical power' (e.g., a pre-test power calculation step) before deciding to switch methods. The mechanism to trigger the fallback is missing from the task list.

The Edge Cases section requires the system to 'fail gracefully with error code ERR_MISSING_VAR' if the dataset lacks specific variables. T013 tasks the team to 'Implement error injection mechanism' but there is no corresponding task to 'Verify dataset variable availability' or 'Implement missing variable detection' before injection, leaving the graceful failure path uncovered.

Tasks T024 and T025 appear twice in the document: once under 'Tests for User Story 2' (as T018/T019 in the list, but labeled T024/T025 in the text block) and again under 'Tests for User Story 3' (labeled T024/T025). This ID collision and duplication creates ambiguity in task tracking and coverage mapping.
